# Mixtral 8x7B Instruct v0.1

Mistral · released 2023-12 · 46.7B params (12.9B active) · apache-2.0

**score 37.2** ±0.7 · #314 of 404 · from 17 benchmark results across 12 sources

Score within the [LMArena (text)](https://whatmodel.sh/?set=lmarena-text) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
download          size  score
4-bit q4_0    ~28.52GB   37.2
4-bit q4_k_m  ~28.52GB   37.2
8-bit q8_0    ~56.54GB   37.2
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_0
ollama run mixtral:8x7b
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run mixtral:8x7b-instruct-v0.1-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run mixtral:8x7b-instruct-v0.1-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
